purpose: Stopped native diagnostic export and immutable host evidence readback
changes: Add a stopped-only round-evidence recovery operation. Expired authority permits evidence recovery, never creation, publication or rotation.

Project only exact task identities/statuses, existing sanitized task diagnostics, native branch booleans and sanitized first errors. Raw payloads, credentials, exception messages and stacks are not exported.
Invalid reconciliation is recorded as unresolved without adopting changed source or candidate identity. Export does not assert resource cleanup or acceptance success.

Persist content-addressed immutable native snapshots, then verify and persist host copies through DriverJournal with exclusive creation, hash checks and bounded no-link readback. Retain earlier snapshots and validate restart reads.
Use the actual fixed Linux CLI for evidence export; only SSH byte transport is substituted. Retain the sanitized artifact after the controller fixture has been removed.

cancelled_predecessor.reason: Known CI-only unbound fixture_root variable; fixed to host work directory and retained safe artifact, no production/cloud affected

limitations: This component does not bind complete host installation, private-material removal or controller-last cloud teardown.
The full Linux A1 failure, native cleanup, real 300-second retry cooldown, A2, B isolation and actual DNS-cutover composition remain pending. Current component cleans A1 and initial DNS records only.
The current Linux node bytes and telemetry are synthetic. Historical Runtime-R4 has a same-hash real-node result, but it is not this component or new R35 node execution.
Evidence export failure must fail acceptance; mandatory resource cleanup still proceeds, rather than leaving billable resources indefinitely.
No new live authorization is created, and the active goal is not complete.

When exact candidate resource identity is unresolved, this export currently reports reconciliation failure and retains source-only diagnostic projections. Separate read-only candidate task diagnostic recovery remains to be added without weakening exact-ID cleanup.
